title.narrative: WBG Public Procurement Reform Support Project

description.narrative: The objective of the IDF grant is to support the Procurement Authority (PA)#s efforts to resume the implementation of top priority procurement reform recommendations of the CPAR 2004 exercise. The proposed grant will focus on the following main areas that would follow the enactment of the new public procurement law: · Completing the reform of the Public Procurement Legal Framework · Establishment of the Public Procurement Policy Unit and related institutional arrangements; · Development of the national standard bidding documents and manuals to sustain the improvements of the procurement law; · Preparation of a national training strategy for public procurement and the initiation of training programs. The objective of the IDF grant is to support the PA's efforts to implement top priority procurement reform actions. The proposed grant will focus on the following main areas that would follow the enactment of the new public procurement law and would create the basis for its effective implementation: Completing the reform of the Public Procurement Legal Framework Support the establishment of the Public Procurement Policy Unit and related institutional arrangements; Development of the national standard bidding documents and manual of procedures to sustain the improvements of the procurement law.
